name: AWS IAM Security Assessment
description: Assessment of AWS Identity and Access Management configurations. Covers IAM policies, roles, users, groups, permission boundaries, service control policies (SCPs) and resource control policies (RCPs), IAM Identity Center (formerly AWS SSO) permission sets, and privilege escalation paths within AWS environments.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to AWS IAM security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands AWS IAM concepts including users, roles, policies, and the shared responsibility model
evidence: Can explain IAM principals, policies, and trust relationships
Understands the difference between identity-based and resource-based policies
Completed AWS IAM security fundamentals training

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reviews IAM configurations under supervision using established checklists and tools
evidence: Runs IAM enumeration tools (e.g., Prowler, ScoutSuite) under guidance
Identifies overly permissive policies using lab review checklists
Documents IAM findings with supervision; work reviewed by authorized personnel

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses IAM posture and identifies privilege escalation paths
evidence: Independently enumerates and reviews IAM configurations across multi-account environments
Identifies privilege escalation paths through role chaining and policy misconfigurations
Produces compliant IAM assessment reports without supervision

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex multi-account IAM assessments; discovers novel escalation techniques; mentors others
evidence: Assesses complex AWS Organizations with nested SCPs and permission boundaries
Develops custom tooling for IAM policy analysis and escalation detection
Reviews IAM assessment work of junior analysts
Contributes to lab IAM assessment methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab IAM assessment methodology; publishes research on AWS IAM attack techniques
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's AWS IAM assessment framework
Published research on novel IAM privilege escalation techniques or policy bypass
Trains teams on advanced AWS IAM security assessment
Recognized as internal or external authority on AWS IAM security

assessment_methods.description: Assess a deliberately misconfigured AWS IAM environment and identify all privilege escalation paths
Review IAM assessment findings from recent engagements for completeness and accuracy

cis: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v5.0.0 - Section 1 Identity and Access Management
